blocks.summary: Vladimir Putin seeks a high-level summit with Trump and Xi to project global influence despite Russia's diminished power. Meanwhile, local events in Australia range from tree clearing in Adelaide parklands for the MotoGP and a tech billionaire's interest in the Hobart stadium, to a teenager surviving six days lost in Victorian bushland, logistics delays freezing small business stock, and unexpected mine pollution potentially aiding an endangered frog population.

sources.title: Why a Trump-Xi-Putin summit is no Yalta 2.0, but is 'Putin's sick fantasy'
